# sha256: c872e64bfb8b1e04bbf0473eb18b880c2e267d93b2dbb0e3be360bf40148a4fc
# knowledge-builder CLI contract (generated by scripts/generate-skill-contract.py; do not edit)

## knowledge-builder ingest — Ingest PDF, video, image, or web url
  <target>  Path or URL to ingest
  --out  Directory for video extracts. Required for video; writes nowhere else.
  --freeze  [flag]  Web url only: write its plain text to _evidence/<run>/sources/<stem>.txt (needs --root, --run, --stem)
  --root  With --freeze: knowledge root
  --run  With --freeze: run id
  --stem  With --freeze: kebab-case file stem

## knowledge-builder gate — Evaluate stopping condition gate
  --root  Knowledge root. With --run-id, counts come from the ledger.
  --run-id  [default='run-001']
  --self-report  [flag]  Integer flags only. Cannot exit 0.
  --required  [type=int; default=5]
  --verified  [type=int]
  --sources  [type=int; default=3]
  --no-code  [flag]
  --no-counterevidence  [flag]
  --contradictions  [type=int]
  --version-mismatch  [flag]
  --rounds  [type=int]
  --delta  [type=float]
  --budget  [type=int; default=10]
  --has-probes  [flag]

## knowledge-builder lint — Lint markdown file against UKMC standard
  <file>  Path to markdown file

## knowledge-builder verify — Verify markdown provenance under a knowledge root
  <root>  External knowledge repository root
  --claims  [flag]  Require each anchor quote to occur in the hashed file. Structural verify stays the default.

## knowledge-builder index — Emit machine-readable index.json
  --root  [required]  External knowledge repository root
  --exclude  [repeatable]  Root-relative glob to skip (default: _evidence/**)

## knowledge-builder run — Init, record, and status for one evidence ledger

## knowledge-builder run init — Create _evidence/<id>/{state.json,evidence.jsonl,sources/}
  --root  [required]  External knowledge repository root
  --id  [required]  Run id (one path segment)
  --budget  [required; type=int]  Call budget frozen into state.json
  --require  [repeatable]  Required claim id, frozen into state.json. Repeat for each id.
  --researcher  Researcher runtime id, frozen into state.json

## knowledge-builder run record — Append one EvidenceAtom JSON object from stdin
  --root  [required]  External knowledge repository root
  --id  [required]  Run id

## knowledge-builder run status — Print the state.json cursor
  --root  [required]  External knowledge repository root
  --id  [required]  Run id

## knowledge-builder run measure — Per-round novelty delta from the ledger
  --root  [required]  External knowledge repository root
  --id  [required]  Run id
  --material  [flag]  Count only novel atoms whose quote an anchor in a module cites
  --write-state  [flag]  Write consecutive_low_delta_rounds and last_weighted_delta into state.json

## knowledge-builder run state — Typed writes to state.json

## knowledge-builder run state set — Set one measured or declared key: consecutive_low_delta_rounds, has_viable_probe_remaining, is_target_version_matched, last_weighted_delta, resolved, round, version_applicability, version_reason
  --root  [required]  External knowledge repository root
  --id  [required]  Run id
  --key  [required]  One of: consecutive_low_delta_rounds, has_viable_probe_remaining, is_target_version_matched, last_weighted_delta, resolved, round, version_applicability, version_reason
  --value  [required]  Value; booleans are true or false

## knowledge-builder query — Filter objects from index.json (read-only)
  --root  [required]  External knowledge repository root
  --object-type
  --status
  --linked-to  Object id linked from or to the result
  --link-type  Restrict --linked-to to one link type
  --implements  Interface the object type implements
  --where  [repeatable]  key=value on an index field (repeatable)
  --fields  Comma list of index fields to return

## knowledge-builder action — Run a typed, verified, logged local write
  <name>  Action type from ontology.yaml (or a default)
  --root  [required]  External knowledge repository root
  --param  [repeatable]  key=value (repeat a key only where the action takes several values, e.g. create-object when/source)
  --batch  JSONL file, one parameter object per line (promote-claim, add-link and other non-creating actions): one verify, all or nothing

## knowledge-builder pack — Scaffold, report on and check an ontology-first knowledge pack

## knowledge-builder pack init — Scaffold a new or empty root: ontology.yaml, templates, claims/, sources/, run
  --root  [required]  New or empty knowledge root
  --topic  [required]  What the pack is about
  --run  Run id (default: <topic>-<yymmdd>)
  --budget  [type=int; default=400]  Call budget frozen into the run (default 400)
  --require  [repeatable]  Required claim id for the run's gate (repeatable)
  --researcher  Researcher runtime id frozen into the run

## knowledge-builder pack status — One-screen report: objects, coverage, gate, saturation
  --root  [required]  Pack root
  --run  Run id (default: pack.json)
  --json  [flag]  Print the report as JSON

## knowledge-builder pack check — verify --claims, coverage, index freshness and the gate; exit 0 only if verify passes
  --root  [required]  Pack root
  --run  Run id (default: pack.json)

## action parameters (--param key=value)
  create-object  always: id, object_type, title; document types add: domain, description, when, source (repeatable: source, when); plus the object type's declared properties
  promote-claim  atom, contradicted_kind, id, into, kind, publisher, run  (batch: JSONL, one object per line)
  set-source  kind, publisher, source  (needs publisher or kind; batch: JSONL)
  add-link  source, link_type, target
  deprecate  target, replacement
  resolve-contradiction  claim, resolution
  promote-trust-tier  target, tier

## run state set --key
  consecutive_low_delta_rounds, has_viable_probe_remaining, is_target_version_matched, last_weighted_delta, resolved, round, version_applicability, version_reason

## atom claim_type
  BENCHMARK, CONTRADICTION, FACT, FAILURE_MODE, INFERENCE

## hosting hosts (never a publisher)
  web.archive.org, raw.githubusercontent.com, githubusercontent.com, github.com, arxiv.org, hackmd.io
